text:
incident-bot: [AUTO-PAGER] P99 latency SLO breach in eu-west-2 router cluster. p99 > 1200ms, streaming stalls increasing. spike_start=1766666600. paging matt (oncall) and raj (runtime).

matt (oncall): on it. seeing alerts + PagerDuty. any idea of scope? customers impacted?

amanda (sre): short scope: ~15% of requests hitting streaming endpoints observe stalls, p95 ~240ms, p99 ~1900ms. error budget burn trending up. dashboard: https://grafana.redwood/euw2/routers/shared (link).

raj (runtime): we rolled out routing policy "weighted_affinity_v2" to euw2 ~2h ago (canary -> 50% -> 100%). I'm seeing heavy stickiness to a small subset of shards. suspect weight skew + seed bug.

raj (runtime): quick evidence:
```
# check policy state on one router
curl -sS http://router-ctrl.eu-west-2.internal/debug/policies | jq '.policies[] | select(.name=="weighted_affinity_v2")'
{
  "name": "weighted_affinity_v2",
  "rollout_id": "rollout-2026-03-15-09",
  "seed": 42,
  "weights": {"shard-42": 0.38, "shard-7": 0.01, "shard-103": 0.02},
  "status": "active"
}
```

amanda (sre): wow that weight distribution is wild. hot shard-42 overloaded -> IO wait and KV cache thrash -> streaming stalls.

dana (product): this rollout was to reduce cross-zone tail by favoring zone affinity. but if seed/weight calculation is off, it can create hot partitions.

matt (oncall): mitigation plan? we should reduce customer impact quickly. options: revert rollout, disable affinity policy for euw2, or temporary traffic steering to other regions. prefer a quick config rollback.

raj (runtime): agree. initiating emergency rollback to previous policy (weighted_affinity_v1) for euw2. will coordinate with deploy-bot.

matt (oncall): please post exact commands and ETA. cs-liaison, prep customer comms: affected customers list?

cs-liaison: pulling affected customer list now, will DM top 3 with active sessions.

raj (runtime): running the revert command now:
```
# revert policy rollout
curl -X POST -u deploy-bot-token: \
  http://config-api.internal/rollouts/rollout-2026-03-15-09/revert \
  -d '{"target":"eu-west-2"}' | jq '.'
```

deploy-bot: Received revert request for rollout-2026-03-15-09 targeting eu-west-2. Applying...

infra-bot: snapshotting router config before change: s3://infra-snapshots/euw2/routers/1766666668.json

matt (oncall): rolling back now. please watch p95/p99 and streaming stall rate.

[~60s pass]

deploy-bot: rollback applied. new active policy: weighted_affinity_v1. change_timestamp=1766666805.

amanda (sre): immediate telemetry: p95=260ms (stable), p99 dropping from 1900ms -> 480ms over last 60s. streaming stall rate down ~9%. still above baseline but trending down.

raj (runtime): initial analysis: seed generation bug in v2 caused non-uniform mapping when weights were sparse; combined with a config templating quirk produced high weight on shard-42. root cause candidate: rounding in the weight normalization codepath. filing PR to patch.

matt (oncall): good. next steps: 1) keep v1 active in euw2, 2) block v2 rollout globally until fix, 3) run a controlled canary with more extensive telemetry, 4) postmortem.

dana (product): agree. I'll pause the feature rollout and update the rollout board.

cs-liaison: customer updates sent to the three affected accounts. no major outages reported but degraded UX for streaming-heavy sessions.

amanda (sre): monitoring: attaching quick queries:
```
# p99 timeseries (last 30m)
SELECT time_bucket('1m', ts) AS minute, percentile_cont(0.99) WITHIN GROUP (value) AS p99
FROM metrics.router_latency
WHERE cluster='euw2' AND endpoint LIKE '/stream%'
AND ts > now() - interval '30 minutes'
GROUP BY minute
ORDER BY minute;
```

matt (oncall): thanks all. I'll mark incident as mitigated once p99 stable < 500ms for 10 consecutive minutes. leaving handoff to raj for postmortem and follow-ups. I'll be reachable for escalation.

raj (runtime): taking postmortem lead. I'll collect logs, diff configs, and open an incident blameless doc. timeline summary will include rollout window, detection, rollback commands and sampling of affected sessions.

amanda (sre): reminder to annotate any customer-visible traces with tag "inc-1766666666" so Optimize/Console can coordinate quality alerts.

deploy-bot: alert: rollout-2026-03-15-09 globally paused by admin (dana).

matt (oncall): closing live mitigation. monitoring window started at 1766666820. will reopen if regression. :white_check_mark:

[THREAD NOTE] This thread contains the root alert and all on-call coordination. Postmortem thread to be created in #postmortems with link when ready.
